NFL Admits Referee Error Cost Rams a Game, Coach Says

Los Angeles Rams head coach Sean McVay stated that the NFL has acknowledged a significant officiating error during a game against the Denver Broncos, which he believes likely resulted in a loss for his team. McVay expressed confidence in kicker Harrison Mevis's range, despite it not being tested in a recent game.
